description: Robinhood Chain deployer alert feed — new_deploy / graduated events, newest first. TWO things a consumer must know: (1) TRADABILITY IS FILTERED BY DEFAULT — alerts on tokens with liquidity_usd < $100 (including unknown liquidity) are dropped, because a $45K-MC alert on a drained $68 pool is not a signal; set include_untradeable=true for the raw tape. The active setting is echoed as tradability_filter. (2) TIER IS RESOLVED AT READ TIME from the live reputation view, so it can never advertise a reputation the deployer has since lost; the snapshot written when the alert fired is returned as tier_at_alert with tier_is_stale flagging a drift. Tiers ride runner_rate ($100K peak MC) + 24h of deployer history, not the $40K graduation rate. Each alert also carries liquidity_usd and current_mc_usd. Poll forward with since=next_event_at, page back with before=next_before. Tier: BASIC (limit capped at 50 below ULTRA).

alert_type.description: Event type — RHC has no bonded/kol_buy alerts

before.description: Only alerts with event_at strictly older than this (ISO 8601 with offset) — pass next_before to page back

deployer_tier.description: Filter on the RESOLVED (current) tier, applied after read-time resolution

include_untradeable.description: true disables the default liquidity_usd >= $100 tradability filter and returns the raw tape

launchpad.description: Filter by launchpad: pons, flap, clanker, hood.fun, noxa, virtuals

limit.description: Number of alerts (1-500; capped at 50 unless ULTRA)

min_mc.description: Minimum market cap at the time the alert fired (mc_at_alert)

offset.description: Pagination offset (used only when no before cursor is given)

since.description: Only alerts with event_at strictly newer than this (ISO 8601 with offset) — the incremental-polling cursor

name: rhc_deployer_alerts
